metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.7 · 2020 · A Beautiful Place to Die: A Martha's Vineyard Mystery
metas.description: A retired Boston PD detective and the acting medical examiner at Martha's Vineyard work together to solve the murder of a mysterious young man.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.7 · 2020 · Riddled with Deceit: A Martha's Vineyard Mystery
metas.description: Former detective Jeff Jackson teams up with Dr. Zee Madieras to track down their friend's missing emerald brooch, a thief, and also - a murderer.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.8 · 2020 · Ships in the Night: A Martha's Vineyard Mystery
metas.description: When an art gallery robbery leads to the death of the contemptible gallery manager, former Boston detective Jeff Jackson teams up with local doctor - and old flame - Dr. Zee Madeiras, to catch the killer.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.7 · 2021 · Poisoned in Paradise: A Martha's Vineyard Mystery
metas.description: When a local waitress is found dead on the beach and a mysterious deposit appears in Zee's bank account, Martha's Vineyard proves to be all but the simple, scenic life Jeff Jackson was after.
